elhelyezes_es_tartalom: INK FOLD: a 360 × 288 × 3.6 cm paper-fibre-faced panel composition with one 72 × 250 × 40 cm graphite storage tower at the south end and a 240 × 44 × 40 cm low four-front cabinet. A broad matte-printed ink gesture crosses the two tower doors but respects their working joint. A 12 cm-wide recessed vertical reveal separates tower and screen field. The television remains on its own structural bracket at the rear wall, within a clear 190 cm screen bay. A thin graphite top line aligns the shallow panels, while the tower deliberately stops lower; shadow reveals show that these are furniture and applied panels.
